content.comment_body: Hi. I'm working on connecting Node-RED to my [product_name] project. Node-RED is functioning on my local network with [product_name], thanks to various online video tutorials. However, when I run Node-RED using AWS and try to connect to [product_name] through AWS, I can't get it online. I'm entering the assigned public IPv4 in Node-RED and have verified that port 102 is not blocked by any firewall. Accessing the public IP with the port in my browser also works. Is there any available guide for this setup?
Are you able to access your [product_name] from AWS using telnet? For instance, you could try this from a Linux instance on AWS.
Please use English in this forum so more people can understand and help you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking cloud-based connectivity between Node-RED and their [product_name] device through AWS, but faces issues transitioning from a local network to the cloud. While they confirm public IP and port access via a browser, Node-RED cannot connect through AWS. Community suggestions include checking network availability with telnet, but there's no confirmed resolution or deeper troubleshooting provided.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates straightforward, well-documented cloud integration of their [product_name] device with Node-RED over AWS, akin to their local network experience.
